changelog: 0.12.10 - Tabs no longer stick when scrolling (title bar + header still do).
0.12.09 - Fixed fullscreen button breaking after compact mode toggle. Title bar, header, and tabs are now sticky so they stay visible when scrolling.
0.12.08 - Title bar buttons redesigned: minus button now toggles compact mode (420x320 window), square button toggles fullscreen (maximized). Tooltips updated.

0.12.07 - Loadout now injects verified enemy traits (from wiki cache) into the AI prompt so it no longer guesses traits from enemy names. Power-ups chip now always shows (even 'none') so you can see the feature is working.
0.12.06 - Fixed update log accordion regex to match the actual `===== timestamp updated to v0.12.xx =====` format (timestamp has spaces so \S+ didn't work).
0.12.05 - Update log now keeps only the 10 most recent entries. Old entries are automatically trimmed when a new update is installed. The existing log was trimmed from 74 to 10 entries.
0.12.04 - Fixed the update log accordion: it now correctly parses the `===== version description =====` format from update_log.txt. Entries are listed newest-first.
0.12.03 - Update Log is now a header button (📋 next to 'Detect save') that opens a fullscreen overlay with the version accordion. Removed the old inline update log from the Detect tab.

0.12.02 - Fixed a brief PowerShell window flashing during app restart/update: all subprocess calls (netstat, powershell process check, taskkill) and the restart Popen now use STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW to suppress console windows.

0.12.01 - Fixed title bar minimize/maximize/close buttons: they now call Flask endpoints directly (via fetch) instead of the unreliable pywebview.js_api bridge. Title bar buttons are now orange to match the AI button theme.

0.12.00 - UI overhaul: (1) Custom frameless title bar with orange/black theme, window controls (minimize/maximize/close). (2) Combos in the loadout result are now clickable chips — click one to highlight the cats it includes with a glow effect. (3) 'Tell the AI what went wrong' textarea now has a Send button so you can trigger regeneration with your feedback. (4) Update log is now an accordion — each version collapses into a clickable header showing the version number, expand to see what changed. (5) Power-ups chip now has a green border when present. (6) All new elements have entrance animations.

0.11.61 - The AI now knows it can switch cat forms when building loadouts. Each cat in the roster shows which forms are unlocked (e.g. 'forms: Base,Evolved,True'), and the AI prompt explains that True forms are usually stronger and should be preferred when available. The AI can recommend any unlocked form - the app uses whichever form it picks.

0.11.60 - AI calls now retry up to 4 extra times (5 total) with exponential backoff (5s, 10s, 20s, 40s) instead of 2 flat retries. When big-pickle drops a request entirely (0 tokens, server-side), the app now detects it specifically and logs 'server dropped request' so you know it wasn't a bad reply. This dramatically improves reliability when the server is flaky.

0.11.59 - All AI calls (loadout, evolve, seed, banners, beat check) now retry up to 2 extra times with a 5-second delay when big-pickle returns an empty or unparseable reply, instead of failing immediately. This handles transient server errors where the model returns 0 tokens.

0.11.56 - Anti-Metal (and other wrong-trait) cats are now auto-swapped if the stage has no matching enemies. If the AI picks a crit unit for a stage with no Metal enemies, it gets replaced with the player's strongest general DPS cat. High-DPS area cats are kept even if they counter a wrong trait.

0.11.46 - Fixed enemy name linking in loadout 'Why' section. Previously, shorter enemy names like 'Bore' would corrupt the HTML of already-linked longer names like 'Nimoy Bore', causing garbled text in the search bar. Now uses a placeholder system that prevents cross-matching.

0.11.43 - Detect error logging fix. The actual error details from the extraction step were being swallowed and only showing 'pipeline aborted'. Now the log shows the real ADB error so you can see exactly what went wrong.

0.11.41 - Detect now also closes the BlueStacks background services (BlueStacksServices.exe) that keep the disk image locked even after BlueStacks itself is closed. That was the reason detect kept failing with 'pipeline aborted' - the save couldn't be extracted while those services held the lock.

0.11.36 - The barrier fix now works the way it actually plays: Starry Aliens (the sparkly cosmic ones) usually have a barrier, but normal Aliens often don't. The AI is now told to look up each enemy's description in the stage info and judge its barrier/shield/wave from what that description says, instead of guessing from the Alien trait or a 'Cyclone'-style name.

0.11.35 - Stopped the AI making up enemy abilities. It used to claim that 'Alien' enemies (and anything with 'Cyclone' in its name) have barriers as a rule, so a loadout for Super Cosmic Cyclone said it has a barrier when it doesn't. Both the loadout and the 'can I beat it' check are now told: only say an enemy has a barrier/shield/wave/surge/warp if the stage page actually names it - never guess it from a trait or a name.

0.11.34 - The Loadout tab now does both jobs with one button: 'Create Loadout' builds your 10-unit loadout and then checks whether your roster can actually beat the stage, showing the verdict (likely win / close call / likely lose + difficulty) right on top of the loadout. The separate 'Can I beat it?' button is gone, and the seed button is now simply 'Track seed'. The Evolve tab also got smarter: 'Almost ready' cats are now sorted so the ones only missing catfruit come first, and every missing item links straight to the wiki page showing which stages drop it.

0.11.33 - Fixed the seed tracker showing the wrong banners. Battle Cats rotates its banners at 11:00 JST every day, and the tracker was waiting for godfat.org's 'current event' flag to move - but that flag can lag for hours, so after a rotation day the tracker kept showing the banner that had just ended and hid the ones actually live. Now the tracker switches to the new rotation the moment 11:00 JST passes (or as soon as godfat flips, whichever is first), so it always tracks the banners that are really in the game.

0.11.32 - Fixed the banner calendar showing things as live before they actually are. Battle Cats rotates its banners and events at 11:00 JST every day, and the app was going by the calendar date alone - so on the day a banner starts (like Epicfest or Ancient Heroes Ultra Souls), the app marked it as on from midnight even though it doesn't appear until the 11am switch. Now a banner that starts today only shows as live from 11:00 JST, and one that ends today stays live until then. The AI sees the same corrected schedule.

0.11.31 - A batch of fixes and polish that were ready on the desktop build: the banner calendar now uses Japan time (banner dates are Japanese, so around midnight the 'today' marker can't land on the wrong day anymore), and there's a Refresh button on the Banner tab to pull the latest schedule right away instead of waiting for the cache. The Seed tab keeps your last tracked result and gacha plan across restarts. The roster filter handles 'vs' abilities properly (e.g. 'Strong vs Red, Alien' stays one clean option instead of splitting). Enemies now recognize the Witch trait and enemy types like Behemoth/Colossus/Sage/Kaijin/Kamikaze. And the seed tracker picks the right banners on a rotation-switch day - the new rotation appears the moment it starts without the old one lingering.

0.11.30 - Stage names are understood much better now. When the wikis don't have a stage, the app falls back to the mygamatoto.com stage database (onestoppress) so Big Pickle still gets a real enemy lineup instead of nothing. If several DIFFERENT stages share the same name the app now shows all of them and warns the AI to confirm which one you mean - 'Journey to Talent', for example, is actually two trials (Holy Valkyrie Cat and Awakened Bahamut). Tower-floor names resolve to the right tower too: 'Heavenly Tower Floor 2' works, and a tower the game doesn't have (like 'Sweet Jesus Tower') can no longer be mistaken for the Infernal Tower.

0.11.29 - Seed tracking is tougher against bc.godfat.org being overloaded: when the server is flaky (it returns 502/500 or times out intermittently, not just all at once), the app now retries up to 6 times with backoff instead of 3, so a rough stretch usually still gets through and shows you the track.

0.11.28 - Seed tracking now handles bc.godfat.org having a rough moment: it retries a fetch up to 3 times when the server is busy (502 / timeout), so a single hiccup no longer aborts the whole run - it shows 'retrying...' and carries on. If godfat is really down it says so clearly (it's a community server that often gets slow right after a game update) instead of dumping a scary error trace, and nothing is wrong with your save.

0.11.27 - Ability names in the Roster are clean now: the numbers no longer look random. Each ability shows its name with the value explained beside it - Barrier Break (100%) means it always breaks barriers, Barrier Break (30%) means 30% per hit, Crit (8%) is the crit chance, Freeze (30%, 2.0s) is chance and duration, Long Distance (170~470) is the attack range. The roster filter dropdown also lists one 'Barrier Break' instead of separate entries for each value, so filtering by ability now actually catches every cat that has it.

0.11.26 - The update check now reads BOTH release mirrors and trusts whichever knows the newest version, so a single slow CDN edge can never hold 'Check for updates' behind by minutes (jsDelivr and raw.githubusercontent can each lag a release at different times - this takes the newest answer). The updater still verifies the downloaded zip really contains the version it promised before installing.

0.11.25 - The update check now reads the release manifest from a mirror that refreshes instantly when a release is published (jsDelivr), with the old server as a backup - so 'Check for updates' can't lag behind a fresh release for minutes anymore. The updater also verifies the downloaded zip really contains the version it promised before installing, and refuses to install if a mirror handed over an older copy.

0.11.24 - Update checks now always get the fresh release info: the check adds a timestamp to the request so GitHub's cache can never serve a stale version.json for a minute or two after a release (that lag is what made the update button show the old version right after publishing).

0.11.23 - Metal + tab indicator fixes: the orange tab underline was hidden behind the active tab's box and now sits just below it. Updates no longer ship your detect baseline (cats_report.json / cats_all.txt), so cats you unlocked long ago won't show up as 'NEW CATS' after an update anymore. Detected cats in the detect result are now clickable and jump straight to that cat in your Roster (enemy counter cards too). The Enemies tab highlights trait tags, warns that Metal enemies only take damage from Critical Hits, and Metal counters now list your actual crit units (Jurassic Cat, Crazed Moneko, Catornado, ...) instead of only cats that target 'Metal'. Big Pickle sees every crit unit tagged [CRIT], gets a clearer metal guideline, and a safety net swaps a crit unit into any metal-stage loadout that lacks one. Also fixed: the app can no longer offer or install an update OLDER than the one you have (that downgrade bug is what made 'Check for updates' say up-to-date after installing).

0.11.22 - Hub and menu polish: the Detect tab is now a proper hub with a time-of-day greeting, stat cards with icons and animated count-up numbers, and a Quick actions grid that jumps straight to Loadout, Seed tracker, Combos, Banners, Evolve or Enemies. Tabs feel livelier: an orange underline glides to the tab you click, panels fade and rise in when switching, and loadout slots cascade in. Plus general polish (button hover/press effects, themed scrollbar and text selection, glowing Detect button) - all in the same colour theme, all disabled if you prefer reduced motion.

0.11.21 - Starting the app is more reliable: double-clicking while it's already running now brings the existing window forward instead of starting a second copy that force-killed the first (that fight is what made the app seem to 'not open' and caused console-flash spam until one copy stuck). The window is restored/brought to front if it was hidden or minimized, and the server now starts before the network refresh so a slow connection can't silently abort the launch.

0.11.20 - Restarting after an update could open a black/blank window: the new instance only waited for *some* server to be on the port, so it could open its window while the old, about-to-die server was still answering (or in the gap while the new server was starting). It now waits until its own server answers HTTP before opening the window, and the old window is closed cleanly on restart instead of the process being killed abruptly - no more orphaned WebView2 processes either.

0.11.19 - The Detect log is cleaner: when BlueStacks was force-closed the save still extracts fine, and it now shows a single calm one-line note instead of a scary wall of 7-Zip 'Headers Error' lines.

0.11.18 - Fixes Detect aborting with 'pipeline aborted' right after auto-closing BlueStacks: force-closing BlueStacks leaves the disk image's guest filesystem needing journal recovery, which made 7-Zip report a 'Headers Error' and exit non-zero even though it extracted the save fine - Detect now treats that as a warning and carries on, and it deletes the previous extracted copy first so a leftover save can never be mistaken for a fresh one.

0.11.17 - The banner calendar no longer shows ended banners as live: any banner whose last day is today or earlier is now marked past (previously ones that already rotated out still showed 'live - 0 days left'). The enemy lookup now shows a much bigger image of the enemy you searched. The 'AI recommendation' button on the Evolve tab shows animated dots while it works. Closing BlueStacks is fully automatic now - no more 'Close BlueStacks App Player?' confirmation to click through.

0.11.16 - Loadouts now always bring a Wave Blocker (e.g. Octopus Cat) when the stage's enemies attack with waves: the AI checks the enemy lineup for wave/surge attacks, and a safety net re-adds a Wave Blocker if a reply still missed one, so a boss's wave can no longer sink an otherwise-winnable loadout. Power-ups are back in loadout building - the AI recommends ones you actually own when they help, and you can force specific power-ups from the loadout options. Detect and Track seed now close BlueStacks for you automatically (the save is flushed as it closes), so you no longer need to shut it down by hand first.

0.11.15 - The seed tracker's Track A and Track B now show 11 rolls each (a full 11-pull), so the guaranteed 11-pull's 11th cat is on screen. Your NP amount is now displayed in three places: a stat card on the Detect tab, the header line, and the seed tracker's resource chips (read straight from the save on Detect / Track seed).

0.11.14 - godfat can keep flagging a just-expired banner as the 'current' one for a few hours after a game update, which kept that old banner visible. Now a banner that ends today is dropped even when godfat still marks it selected: after an update you immediately see the new rotation (Komori / Summer / Mamoluga plus the permanent Platinum and Legend capsules), and the newest live banner is used as the current one for the AI plan.

0.11.13 - Rotations now replace instead of stack: when a new gacha rotation starts, the old banners that end that day are skipped automatically so the new capsules take their place. The current banner stays through its final day and disappears on its own once godfat switches to the new current event.

0.11.12 - Fixed the seed tracker dropping banners: when a new gacha rotation starts on the same day the old one ends (like today's update), the new capsules were never fetched because the list was capped at 4. Now every live banner is shown and used by the AI plan.

0.11.11 - The roster has a new filter dropdown: pick any ability (e.g. Crit 100%, Strong vs Red), immunity (e.g. Warp, Wave) or targeted trait (e.g. Red, Aku) to narrow the list to cats that have it. The header now shows the version the roster data actually is, and when the game updates a warning banner appears telling you to hit Detect - which now re-fetches the data for the new version automatically.

0.11.10 - The seed tracker is now a true one-button flow: the separate 'Re-run plan' button is gone, so nothing can double-trigger the AI plan. The single 'Track seed + AI plan' button does everything, and pressing it again cancels any in-flight plan before re-tracking.

0.11.9 - 'Track seed' now also runs the AI plan automatically, so the gacha plan appears right after the tracks instead of needing a second button press (the AI plan button is now a 'Re-run plan' option). The update log in the app now shows all releases including 0.11.6-0.11.8.

0.11.8 - Loadouts are much faster: asking for the same stage with the same roster loads instantly from cache, and stage wiki text is cached too. The abilities panel is fixed (no more fake '2nd/3rd Attack' labels; real 'Multi-Hit (N hits)' with the hit that carries abilities) and now includes Mini-Wave, Behemoth Dodge and Explosion. The roster has a new Immune column, loadout slots show each cat's immunities, and the AI uses those immunities when picking walls and tanks. Scrollbars are back to the native light look.

0.11.7 - Fixed the seed tracker: Platinum/Legend capsules now show the real rarity of each cat (ubers were being shown as Rare/Super), the fake 'Super+'/'Uber+' labels are gone, fest slots show the true cat, names like D'arktanyan render properly, and the two side-by-side lists are labeled Track A (your next rolls) and Track B (the alternate path from a guaranteed 11-pull).

0.11.6 - New automatic seed tracking: roll in the gacha, close BlueStacks, hit Track seed. The app reads your seed straight from the save, pulls the live track from bc.godfat.org and shows what you'll roll next on every active banner (including Platinum and Legend capsules), then asks the AI for a concrete roll plan.
0.11.5 - The app window now brings itself to the front on start so it can't hide behind a fullscreen browser and look blank. The Downloading / Restarting statuses now show animated dots.
